import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

fails = []
def check(name, events, want_status, want_raw=None, origin='rack-a', routes=None, sid=0):
    s = scen(routes=routes, events=events)
    r = run(s)
    rec = stream_result(r, sid)
    got = rec['status']
    if got != want_status:
        fails.append('%s: status %r != %r' % (name, got, want_status)); return
    if want_status == 'forwarded':
        if want_raw is not None:
            gotraw = raw(r, origin)[rec['offset']:rec['offset']+rec['length']]
            if gotraw != want_raw:
                fails.append('%s: raw %r != %r' % (name, gotraw, want_raw))
        if rec['length'] != len(want_raw) if want_raw is not None else False:
            pass
    else:
        for k in ('commit_at','origin','offset','cache_key'):
            if rec[k] is not None:
                fails.append('%s: %s should be null' % (name, k))
        if rec['length'] != 0:
            fails.append('%s: length should be 0' % name)
        if any(v != '' for v in r['origins'].values()):
            fails.append('%s: pipelines should be empty: %r' % (name, r['origins']))

def H(**kw): return hdr(0, *base_headers(**kw))

# ---- structure ----
check('data-before-headers', [data(0,'41'), H(), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('third-headers', [H(), hdr(0), hdr(0), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('data-after-trailer', [H(), hdr(0), data(0,'41'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('no-headers', [fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('fin-only-unknown', [unk(0), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('unknown-before-headers', [unk(0), H(), unk(0), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('unknown-after-trailer', [H(), hdr(0), unk(0), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n')
check('trailer-only-headers-no-fin', [H()], 'incomplete')
check('reset-only', [reset(0)], 'cancelled')
check('fin-after-data-no-headers', [data(0,'00'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('body-limit-ok', [H(), data(0, 'aa'*65536), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('body-limit-over', [H(), data(0, 'aa'*65536), data(0,'aa'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('body-split-ok', [H(), data(0,'ab'*100), data(0,'cd'*100), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('empty-data-events', [H(), data(0,''), data(0,''), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# ---- methods / schemes ----
for m in ['GET','HEAD','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE','OPTIONS']:
    check('method-'+m, [H(method=m), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
for m in ['get','TRACE','CONNECT','','POST ']:
    check('bad-method-'+repr(m), [H(method=m), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('scheme-http', [H(scheme='http'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('scheme-HTTP', [H(scheme='HTTP'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('scheme-ws', [H(scheme='ws'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('scheme-ftp', [H(scheme='ftp'), fin(0)], 'rejected')

# ---- pseudo ----
check('missing-path', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('missing-scheme', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('missing-method', [hdr(0, [":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('dup-method', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('pseudo-after-regular', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],["x-a","b"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('unknown-pseudo', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],[":protocol","connect-udp"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('pseudo-status', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],[":status","200"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('authority-missing-host', [H(authority=None), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('authority-empty', [H(authority=''), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('host-fallback', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":path","/"],["host","demo.test"]), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
check('host-fallback-empty', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":path","/"],["host",""]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('host-dup', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":path","/"],["host","demo.test"],["host","demo.test"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('auth-host-same', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],["host","demo.test"]), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('auth-host-diff', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],["host","Demo.Test"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('auth-host-diff2', [hdr(0, [":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","Demo.Test"],[":path","/"],["host","demo.test"]), fin(0)], 'rejected')

# ---- path ----
for p in ['/', '/a/b', '/a%2Fb', '*', '/?q=1', '/x?a=1&b=2', '/-', '/._~!$&\'()*+,;=:@/?', '/%ff', '/%FF', '/a%0Ab']:
    check('path-ok-'+p, [H(path=p, method='OPTIONS' if p=='*' else 'GET'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
for p in ['', '//', '//a', '/a b', '/a%2', '/a%zz', '/a%2G', '/a#b', '/a\\b', '/\u00e9', 'https://demo.test/', 'a/b', '/a[b]', '/a]b', '/A%2f', '*', '/ ']:
    m = 'GET'
    check('path-bad-'+repr(p), [H(path=p, method=m), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('star-get', [H(path='*', method='GET'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('star-post', [H(path='*', method='POST'), fin(0)], 'rejected')
check('star-options', [H(path='*', method='OPTIONS'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('origin-form-options', [H(path='/x', method='OPTIONS'), fin(0)], 'forwarded')
check('path-preserved', [H(path='/a%2Fb?x=1&x=2'), fin(0)], 'forwarded',
      b'GET /a%2Fb?x=1&x=2 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')
print('FAILS:', len(fails))
for f in fails: print(' -', f)
